lines.t: Graveyard Shift at KLCQ
Tiny Town Station, half past two
DJ Danny with his coffee cold
Spinning soft rock feeling old
Clicks a file he's never seen
Volumes of Truth Program 13
Shugs and says what could go wrong
Then a thunder voice cuts through his song
He said, awake my people, the time is near
You snooze in comfort but the trumpet's clear
Danny froze with his donut bite
Said, uh, folks, that wasn't me tonight
Now the phones light up like a neon sign
Be caller one, caller two, now line
Every heart on the other end of the line
Get shaken by a word that's way too fine
Awake my people, open your eyes
Stop dreaming under darkened skies
DJ sweating through his scripted line
Waiting on the voice of caller number nine
Caller three says, man, that hit deep
Been drifting so long I fell asleep
Call of five says who's reading that
It feels like I just crashed my chat
Danny taps keys, tries to fade it out
But every button just reroutes
The program jumps back, fills the air
Behold the last trumpet, I've laid it bare
You said you cling to shadows, but I am here
Turn from the dark, come back to me
Danny whispers, this ain't in my law
Producer text, just blame it on the fall
Now the phones light up like a neon sign
Call a six, call a seven, cross the line
Every voice saying something's wrong
But this strange broadcast feels so strong
Awake my people, your sleep must end
Judgment is coming, but I still befriend
He reads the cue on the little screen
Call her number nine, smart name unseen
Line nine crackles, voice real low
Hey DJ, I thought you should know
Been running from God since 92
But tonight those letters cut me through
And it said, oh wait, the time has come
I heard my name in every drum
I pulled my car to the shoulder side
Been crying here with the radio wide
Danny swallows, tosses out his script
Says, friend, sounds like your heart just flipped
Call a nine laughs through a broken tone
Says, feels like he read me on a microphone
Now the bold lights fade but the truth stays bright
Dead air filled with a living light
No more games, no can't lie
Just a DJ praying with call of night
Wake my people, the playback said
Turn from the brink, come home instead
Instead, Danny kills the ass, lets silence ring
Says if you're still listening, this is your day
Morning crew walks in at 6.04
Finds Danny Terry on the studio floor
Says we don't know where that file came from
But half the town just beat the drum
They rename the slide, the graveyard time, the volumes that will wake up blind
And every night round 209, he listens close for caller number nine
